column1: # Expected compiler warnings of the Runner build of a real app (eleven native plugins).
# One row per warning, as three tab-separated columns: package folder (name and version), file inside it, message.
# The message has Swift's trailing [#Group] tag removed; clang's [-Wflag] is kept. Line numbers are left out on
# purpose: they change when a file is edited without adding a warning. Compare the rows of a new build with these as a
# multiset; a row that is not here is a new warning.
# Source: the log of one build on 2026-11-02 (Flutter 3.47.5, Swift 6.4, iOS SDK 26.5, swift-build). The log has 44 lines
# with "warning:" because Swift prints each warning twice, once as its headline and once in the code excerpt; there are
# 23 distinct warnings. They come from three plugins' own sources. None comes from the app's runner sources or from the
# remote SwiftPM packages (the payments SDK, the Google sign-in chain).
# When a plugin or the toolchain is updated, rebuild, review the differences, and replace this file in the same pull request.
